lines.zh: 我顺着水流摆尾，锦鳞一闪一闪。
lines.en: I flick my tail downstream, scales flashing gold.

lines.zh: 河水推着我走，橙白花纹晃成一片。
lines.en: The current carries me along, my orange patches swaying.

lines.zh: 我在浅滩打了个转，鳞片蹭过卵石。
lines.en: I turn over the shallows, scales brushing the pebbles.

lines.zh: 一群锦鲤同游，水花整齐得像排练过。
lines.en: The whole shoal swims in step, ripples almost rehearsed.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍拍开水面，留下一圈金边。
lines.en: My tail fin slaps the surface, leaving a ring of gold.

lines.zh: 绕过水草时，我把身子压得很低。
lines.en: I duck low as I slip past the river weeds.

lines.zh: 逆流而上时，我全身的鳞都在用力。
lines.en: Swimming upstream, every scale seems to strain.

lines.zh: 我领着同伴游过桥洞，波纹很安静。
lines.en: I lead the shoal under the bridge in quiet ripples.

lines.zh: 白底红斑的我在浑水里也显眼。
lines.en: White with red spots, I stand out even in murky water.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底前行，背鳍轻轻竖起。
lines.en: I skim the riverbed, dorsal fin barely raised.

lines.zh: 转弯时我甩了一下尾巴，溅起小水珠。
lines.en: A flick of my tail throws up tiny beads of water.

lines.zh: 我和同伴并排游，花纹像拼起来的锦缎。
lines.en: Side by side with my kin, our patterns make brocade.

lines.zh: 水面结冰时，我在下层慢慢划动。
lines.en: Beneath the ice I paddle slowly through the dark.

lines.zh: 我绕过落进水里的树枝，鳞光碎成几段。
lines.en: I skirt a sunken branch, my gleam breaking apart.

lines.zh: 我摆尾穿过水草的缝隙。
lines.en: I flick through a gap in the waterweeds.

lines.zh: 我从石头下钻出，鳞上带沙。
lines.en: I slip from under a stone, sand on my scales.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，背鳍划出一道线。
lines.en: I swim at the surface, dorsal fin drawing a line.

lines.zh: 群鱼让开一条路，我游在中间。
lines.en: The shoal parts; I swim through the middle.

lines.zh: 我悬在水中央，让鳃慢慢开合。
lines.en: I hang mid-current, gills opening and closing slowly.

lines.zh: 停在水草阴影里，我几乎不动。
lines.en: Resting in the weed shadow, I barely stir.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，吞下一口河水又吐出。
lines.en: I mouth the river water, then let it go.

lines.zh: 一群锦鲤挤在一起，谁也没在赶路。
lines.en: The shoal clusters together with nowhere to be.

lines.zh: 阳光透过水面，我的鳞发亮。
lines.en: Sunlight through the water lights my quiet scales.

lines.zh: 我把头探出水面，看一眼岸上的草。
lines.en: I poke my head up to glance at the bank.

lines.zh: 气泡从我嘴边升起，一串一串地散。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from my mouth and scatter upward.

lines.zh: 我靠在卵石旁休息，尾鳍轻轻摆动。
lines.en: I rest by a stone, tail fin swaying gently.

lines.zh: 河底的沙纹映着我身上的花纹。
lines.en: Sand ripples on the riverbed mirror my patterns.

lines.zh: 我不急着游，只让水流替我挪动。
lines.en: I let the water do the moving for me.

lines.zh: 水草摇，我也跟着摇，谁都不说话。
lines.en: The weeds sway, I sway, and nothing is said.

lines.zh: 我把嘴贴向水面，吸了一口凉气。
lines.en: I press my mouth to the surface and sip the cool.

lines.zh: 河湾很静，只有我的鳍在打拍子。
lines.en: The bend is still but for my fin keeping time.

lines.zh: 我悬着，等这条河给我一点运气。
lines.en: I hover, waiting for the river to hand me luck.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，我隔着水看你的影子。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank; I watch your shadow through water.

lines.zh: 我浮上来，用圆眼睛打量你的靴子。
lines.en: I surface and study your boots with round eyes.

lines.zh: 你把桶探进水里，我绕着你转圈。
lines.en: You lower a bucket; I circle you warily.

lines.zh: 我记得你，上次也是你来看鱼。
lines.en: I remember you; you came to see the fish before.

lines.zh: 我对着你张嘴，像在问有没有吃的。
lines.en: I open my mouth at you as if asking for food.

lines.zh: 你的脸映在水里，被我的尾鳍搅散。
lines.en: Your face in the water breaks under my tail.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让你看清我背上的花纹。
lines.en: I turn sideways so you can see my back pattern.

lines.zh: 我贴着你伸进水里的手指游过。
lines.en: I swim past the fingers you dangle in the river.

lines.zh: 你站了很久，我也看了你很久。
lines.en: You stand a long while; I watch just as long.

lines.zh: 我抬头，嘴一张一合，像在打招呼。
lines.en: I tilt up, mouth working, as close to a greeting as I get.

lines.zh: 我的鳞被刮掉一片，河水刺痛它。
lines.en: A scale is scraped away and the river stings it.

lines.zh: 我猛地一摆尾，往水草深处钻。
lines.en: I thrash my tail and dive into the deep weeds.

lines.zh: 受伤的鱼最容易被同伴挤到一边。
lines.en: A hurt fish is the first one the shoal pushes aside.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，肚皮朝上又急忙正过来。
lines.en: I flip belly-up and hurriedly right myself.

lines.zh: 血丝在水里散开，我赶紧游开。
lines.en: A thread of red spreads; I swim clear of it.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半天不敢浮上水面。
lines.en: This keeps me from the surface for a long while.

lines.zh: 我的鳍垂着，游起来歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: My fin droops and I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，只露出一截尾巴。
lines.en: I hide in a stone crack with only my tail out.

lines.zh: 伤处一碰水就疼，我尽量不动。
lines.en: The wound stings in the water, so I keep still.

lines.zh: 同伴围过来，用头轻轻碰我的侧腹。
lines.en: The shoal gathers and nudges my flank with their heads.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎屑落水，我立刻掉头。
lines.en: Crumbs hit the water and I turn on the spot.

lines.zh: 水面浮着几片嫩叶，是我今晚的念想。
lines.en: A few tender leaves float by, my whole evening's wish.

lines.zh: 那群锦鲤都往同一处挤，我也跟过去。
lines.en: The shoal crowds one spot, and I crowd with it.

lines.zh: 闻到味道，我的鳍比脑子快一步。
lines.en: I smell it and my fins move before my mind does.

lines.zh: 我绕着那块食物打转，先看有没有钩。
lines.en: I circle the morsel first, checking for a hook.

lines.zh: 有吃的漂来，连最怕人的鱼也凑近。
lines.en: Food drifts in, and even the shyest fish comes close.

lines.zh: 我把头一拱，把浮萍顶得散开。
lines.en: One nudge of my head scatters the floating weed.

lines.zh: 你手里的饵一动，我的尾巴就不听话。
lines.en: Your bait twitches and my tail stops obeying me.

lines.zh: 河面上飘来香味，整群鱼都醒了。
lines.en: A scent crosses the river and the whole shoal wakes.

lines.zh: 我冒出水面试探，嘴已经张好了。
lines.en: I rise to test the surface, mouth already open.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的腿，鳞片把你蹭湿了。
lines.en: I bump your leg and leave scales and water on it.

lines.zh: 两条锦鲤撞在一起，尾巴打了个结。
lines.en: Two koi knock together, tails in a brief knot.

lines.zh: 我擦过石岸，背鳍被磨得有点痒。
lines.en: I scrape the stone bank and my dorsal fin itches.

lines.zh: 挤在鱼群里，我的花纹和别人的重叠。
lines.en: In the crush of fish my pattern overlaps another's.

lines.zh: 你收腿时踢起水花，我被推得转半圈。
lines.en: Your leg kicks up spray and spins me half around.

lines.zh: 我和同伴顶了一下头，谁也没让开。
lines.en: My kin and I butt heads and neither of us yields.

lines.zh: 水太挤，我的尾鳍只能贴着身子收。
lines.en: It is crowded; I fold my tail fin against my side.

lines.zh: 我撞到沉木，掉了几片鳞在水底。
lines.en: I hit a sunken log and lose a few scales to the bed.

lines.zh: 桶壁太窄，我转个身就撞到另一条。
lines.en: The bucket is narrow; one turn and I hit another fish.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里蹭到你的靴子，凉凉的。
lines.en: I brush your boot in the shallows, cool and slick.

lines.zh: 两群锦鲤在桥下交汇，撞得水响。
lines.en: Two shoals meet under the bridge with a wet knock.

lines.zh: 我一头扎进芦苇，晃得叶子乱颤。
lines.en: I blunder into the reeds and set the stems shaking.

lines.zh: 我追着那条红斑最艳的锦鲤绕圈。
lines.en: I chase the koi with the brightest red patches in circles.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，尾鳍一前一后地摆。
lines.en: We swim abreast, our tails beating one after the other.

lines.zh: 求偶时我把花纹全展开给她看。
lines.en: Courting, I spread every bit of my pattern for her.

lines.zh: 河湾里两条锦鲤贴得很近，很安静。
lines.en: Two koi press close in the bend, very quiet.

lines.zh: 我用头轻轻顶她的腹侧，她不躲。
lines.en: I nudge her flank; she does not pull away.

lines.zh: 我们绕着水草转，谁也没先停下。
lines.en: We circle the weeds and neither stops first.

lines.zh: 她的橙白斑比河水更亮，我跟着她。
lines.en: Her orange-white patches outshine the river, and I follow.

lines.zh: 成对的锦鲤会一起守着一块卵石。
lines.en: Paired koi keep watch over the same smooth stone.

lines.zh: 我们的鳞碰在一起，发出细小的响。
lines.en: Our scales click together, a very small sound.

lines.zh: 这一季的河水，够我们养一群小鱼了。
lines.en: This season's river can raise a shoal of our young.

lines.zh: 桶口一罩下来，我撞了两下桶壁。
lines.en: The bucket drops; I knock the wall twice.

lines.zh: 水被舀起时我也跟着离开了河。
lines.en: The water scoops up and I leave the river with it.

lines.zh: 隔着一层桶壁，河水的声音变闷了。
lines.en: Through the bucket the river sounds muffled.

lines.zh: 我在桶里转不开身，只能看着你。
lines.en: Cramped in the pail, I can only look up at you.

lines.zh: 被拎起来时，我尾巴溅了你一手水。
lines.en: Lifted out, my tail splashes your hand.

lines.zh: 桶里的水晃，我的花纹也跟着晃。
lines.en: The pail sways and my pattern sways with it.

lines.zh: 我成了你带回家的那条锦鲤。
lines.en: I am the koi you are taking home.

lines.zh: 离开河流，我的鳞在桶底磕出轻响。
lines.en: Out of the river, my scales tap the pail bottom.

lines.zh: 搬动时水洒了，我贴着桶边喘。
lines.en: Water sloshes on the move; I gasp against the rim.

lines.zh: 你盖上桶盖，我只剩一小片天。
lines.en: You cap the pail and my sky shrinks to nothing.

lines.zh: 水面上有只小虫，我盯住它的影子。
lines.en: A bug on the surface; I fix on its shadow.

lines.zh: 我发现了那只落水的蛾子，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I spot a drowned moth and drift toward it.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼闯进我的水面，我记下它。
lines.en: A small fish crosses my patch of surface; I mark it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了一片漂动的嫩叶，准备下口。
lines.en: I lock onto a drifting leaf and get ready to bite.

lines.zh: 有东西在水里扑腾，我调头去看。
lines.en: Something thrashes in the water; I turn to look.

lines.zh: 我把目光定在那串气泡的源头。
lines.en: I fix my gaze on whatever makes those bubbles.

lines.zh: 一条泥鳅钻过石缝，我跟上了。
lines.en: A loach slips through the stones and I follow.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛锁住水面的一点微光。
lines.en: My eyes lock onto a glimmer on the surface.

lines.zh: 目标只是一只虫子，但我很认真。
lines.en: The target is only a bug, but I take it seriously.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，这次不是食物。
lines.en: I know you now, and this time you are not food.

lines.zh: 我悬在那只虫下方，等它再靠近一点。
lines.en: I hover under the bug, waiting for it to drift closer.

lines.zh: 尾鳍慢慢摆，我在算距离。
lines.en: Tail beating slowly, I am measuring the distance.

lines.zh: 我的嘴对准水面，一动不动。
lines.en: My mouth lines up with the surface and holds.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼往左，我的头也往左。
lines.en: The little fish goes left; my head goes left.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，让水面的光不暴露我。
lines.en: I sink lower so the surface glare will not betray me.

lines.zh: 盯着目标时，我连鳞都懒得动。
lines.en: Watching the target, I do not even bother to flex a scale.

lines.zh: 我在等它低头，等那一瞬间。
lines.en: I wait for it to dip its head, for that one instant.

lines.zh: 它一停，我的鳃也跟着停了一下。
lines.en: It pauses, and my gills pause with it.

lines.zh: 我把整群鱼带到下游，围住那点动静。
lines.en: I bring the shoal downstream to close around the noise.

lines.zh: 我们几个分头盯着，谁先动谁先吃。
lines.en: We split the watching; whoever moves first eats first.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住那只虫，水花很小。
lines.en: I snap up the bug with barely a splash.

lines.zh: 嘴一吸，水面上的东西就没了。
lines.en: One suck of my mouth and the surface is empty.

lines.zh: 我咬偏了，只叼到一嘴水草。
lines.en: I miss and come up with a mouthful of weed.

lines.zh: 那一口很轻，但对虫子是全部。
lines.en: The bite is light; for the bug it is everything.

lines.zh: 我侧身一扑，把蛾子拖进水里。
lines.en: I lunge sideways and drag the moth under.

lines.zh: 咬住后我甩了甩头，让它别挣扎。
lines.en: Holding it, I shake my head to stop the struggle.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，只咬水面上会动的东西。
lines.en: I do not bite people, only things that move on water.

lines.zh: 一口下去，我的鳞都跟着震了一下。
lines.en: One bite and the shock runs through my scales.

lines.zh: 咬空了，我悻悻地沉回水草里。
lines.en: I miss, and sulk back down into the weeds.

lines.zh: 那群鱼一起开口，水面响成一片。
lines.en: The shoal bites as one and the surface clatters.

lines.zh: 河里多了一小群锦鲤，橙白相间。
lines.en: A small shoal of koi appears, orange and white.

lines.zh: 我在浅水醒来，鳞上还挂着水珠。
lines.en: I wake in the shallows with beads on my scales.

lines.zh: 这段河道水草够密，我决定住下。
lines.en: The weeds here are thick; I decide to stay.

lines.zh: 出生的第一件事，是找同伴的方向。
lines.en: My first act is to find which way the shoal went.

lines.zh: 我从卵石缝里钻出来，鳍还软。
lines.en: I wriggle out from the stones, fins still soft.

lines.zh: 晨光落在河上，我的花纹第一次发亮。
lines.en: Dawn falls on the river and my pattern shines for the first time.

lines.zh: 这条河的水温刚好，我摆尾试了试。
lines.en: The river is just warm enough; I test it with a flick.

lines.zh: 我自带一点运气，游过的地方都亮。
lines.en: I carry a little luck; the water brightens where I pass.

lines.zh: 水面破开，我带着一身新鳞出现。
lines.en: The surface parts and I appear in fresh scales.

lines.zh: 同伴们已经在下游等我入群。
lines.en: The shoal waits downstream for me to join.

lines.zh: 河水被烤热，我贴着河底逃。
lines.en: The river turns warm and I flee along the bottom.

lines.zh: 我从水里被甩到岸上，拼命拍尾。
lines.en: Flung from the water onto the bank, I slap my tail.

lines.zh: 我在水里也会呛，鳃里全是沙。
lines.en: Even in water I choke, gills full of sand.

lines.zh: 冲击波把整群鱼掀得翻白。
lines.en: The blast flips the whole shoal belly-up.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进水里，擦过我的背鳍。
lines.en: An arrow stabs the water and grazes my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 一股怪力扯住我的鳞，往岸上拉。
lines.en: A strange force tugs my scales toward the bank.

lines.zh: 饿得久了，我的花纹都暗下去。
lines.en: Too long hungry, my colors dim.

lines.zh: 雷劈在河面，我整条鱼都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the river and numbs me head to tail.

lines.zh: 河水忽然没了底，我一直往下沉。
lines.en: The river loses its floor and I keep sinking.
